v: Nithiin back on HIT track 😄 Organic farming message pakkana petti Venky Kudumula full comedy mode lo velthadu. Second half nunchi proper commercial timepass.
e: Bheeshma uses organic farming as its plot foundation but Venky Kudumula keeps the message secondary to entertainment. The first half is okay, the post-interval comedy lifts the film considerably, and Nithiin, Vennela Kishore, Raghu Babu and the stylish presentation make it an easy commercial watch if you leave logic at the door.
body:
Nitin is back again on HIT track!!!

plot wise the concept of ORGANIC FARMING was kicked aside by director Venky’s narration style…..womder how different directors have different style, if the same plot had Koratala Siva directing it he would have made it a commericially serious message oriented movie with top notch and stylish action scenes…..but Venky choose a different style of mixing entertainment to the message oriented subject. Though the message is almost dominated by the Comedy, but it never dissapoints the general entertainment loving audience!!!!

The first part was okay and with the Interval twist…..I thought the second half would be on serious note and all the hype about the comedy in the movie is just a bluff. But with immediate post interval scene the director showed his true intentions of never leaving the comedy angle and that where the fun starts!!!!!

All the comedy One liners punches and irritating meme lines by Nitin have been well written!!!! Raghu Babu and Vennala Kishore combination rocks to the core!!!!

the movie is shot quite stylishisly and the BGM is apt with couple of hit songs!!!! Fights are good…surprisingly songs didnt give much chance for Nitins dance moments and the only mass song had Rashmika getting all the attention!!!

overall its pakka commericial entertainer with lots of comedy in 2nd half with hero doing all the bafoonery acts and still being an Hero!!! Dont expect any message or Logic from the movie and you will love it…..

v: EXCELLENT!!!!! 🙏 Simple, realistic and no unnecessary melodrama. Kangana super, supporting cast perfect... theatre aina OTT aina, just watch it.
e: Panga takes a story that could easily have been pushed into loud melodrama and tells it with wonderful simplicity and realism instead. Ashwiny Iyer Tiwari gets the emotions right, Kangana Ranaut is superb, and the entire supporting cast helps turn it into an effortless must-watch.
body:
Excellent!!!!! How can one make a movie with such a story in a simple & realistic way without any melodrama!!!!! For me there was no one scene which looked un-realistic and director Ashwiny Iyer Tiwari did a fantastic job to get the emotions right!!!!

we all know Kangana is a fantastic and natural actor and man she is a super star _/_ she portrayed all the emotions of a House Wife with a dream in perfect way!!!! apart from her all the other actors : Jassi Gill, Richa Chadda & Neena Gupta did perfect job….spl mention of the kid who played the Son!!!!

Music and BGM perfectly blend with the mood of the film….Dialogues are simple yet makes complete sense!!!

irrespective of you watch it in Theaters or OTT…..its a must watch!, the sooner the better!!!

v: Sci-fi idea bagundi, retro setup interesting... but Ravi Teja energy motham concept ni swallow chesindi 😄 Thaman + Sunil save enough to make it just above average.
e: Disco Raja throws sci-fi, retro styling and regular mass cinema into the same mixer, but Vi Anand never fully balances the concept with Ravi Teja’s trademark energy. There are interesting ingredients — especially Sunil’s return and Thaman’s terrific music and BGM — yet the film ultimately lands only a little above average.
body:
personally I fell like its Vi.Anand’s version of Ismart Shankar…..where Sci-fi and regular mass have been thrown together into a mixer!!!!!

the major problem with having Ravi Teja is as a director you need to ensure to make use of his energy levels and comedy timing, else certain ppl will feel the movie is slow and dull AND if you utilize it, he will takeover the whole movie with his High energy levels and the whole concept and story takes back seat…..and that is where Vi Anand failed in balancing & blending Ravi Tejas energy with the concept and story!!!!

though the sci-fi concept, Retro setup & Re-introduction of Sunil create an interest…….Ravi Teja with his high energy as Disco Raja completely over shadows everything and that’s where you start feeling the movie as routine!!!!

other than Ravi Teja…its Thaman’s terrific BGM & music along with Sunil which will get our attention _/\_

overall its neither Good nor Bad movie but above average!!!

v: Story first 10 mins lone ardham aipothundi... still I liked it to the core 😄 Bunny + Murali Sharma + Trivikram comedy/emotions + Thaman make this simple family story work big time.
e: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo reveals its basic story almost immediately, yet Trivikram keeps the film engaging through comedy, family emotions and strong character work. Allu Arjun gets a full showcase, Murali Sharma is a terrific second pillar, and Thaman’s chartbusters and BGM give this simple commercial film plenty of life.
body:
very rarely you see a film where you cant point out any outstanding points but still you like the film to the core (just like Seethama Vakitlo Sirimalle Chettu) and Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo falls in that category!!!!

you can know what the story of the film is just within first 10 mins but still Trivikram’s command over comedy and family emotions, Murali Sharma’s excellent characterization and brilliant acting and Allu Arjun’s all rou d performance ensures you are engaged for the whole length!!!!

Because of the wraper thin Family story, Trivikram didnt got a chance to show his intellectual brilliance in dialogues just like Aravinda Sametha or Julai or Khaleja but still he had his pen going on with few of his mark dialogues scattered over the films length!!!!

Allu Arjun is back with a bang as he got a brilliant oppurtunity to portray Comedy, Emotion, Mass Fights and Class Fights in a single movie…..and he once again proved that he is the best in the lot of Tollywood dancers with his trademark graceful steps which look simple yet difficult to perform _/_……..Spl mention of the dance episode in the office board room which has similar impact to one that of Gabbar Singh’s Anthakshari scene and he cleverly ensured to satisfy the EGO of PK fans!!!!

Trivikram and Fight Masters have ensured that all fights are authentically shot!!!!

Unlike Agyathavasi & Aravindha this time Trivikram took extra care to not spoil the impact of. chartbuster songs with picturization……The leading scenes picturization and locations/sets for all the songs sync in perfectly!!!!

On screen if Allu Arjun is one pillar than Murali Sharma is another pillar for this movie and his
characterization and acting create a huge impact to hate him through out the film!!! apart from Murali Sharma and Sachin all other STAR actors are used more or less like junior actors 😦

Thaman gave life to this movie with his chartbuster songs and ultra kool BGM!!!

overall its a simple and cool film and a must watch for Allu Arjun and Murali Sharma…..it will create an Impact in A centers but may be impacted by Sarlieeru in B & C centers!!!
